summary: Created a 5-phase plan implementing the report's recommendation (option (a), re-wire). Phase 1 is an atomic-batch two-file change: add `import FormalSystem.Metalogic.Algebraic` to FormalSystem/Metalogic.lean and delete the five now-stale entries plus rewrite two comment blocks in scripts/module-invariants-manifest.txt -- either file alone leaves C6 red, so they must land in one commit. Phases 2-4 run in parallel and correct the documented overstatements: eight sites in Algebraic/README.md (including both overstatements the task named), four in Metalogic/README.md, and a scoped adjudication note in the two Boneyard READMEs that keeps the elaboration warning in force for the untested UltrafilterFrame.lean/TenseS5Algebra.lean. Phase 5 is the full acceptance gate. The plan does NOT re-run the Variant B experiment -- F4 already measured it -- and does not widen scope to Core.lean/Bundle.lean/SoundnessLemmas.lean per D4.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase, 2.75-hour plan wiring the Algebraic aggregator into the build graph and correcting fourteen documentation claims across four READMEs.

decisions_made: Phase 1 declared Commit Mode: atomic-batch over exactly {FormalSystem/Metalogic.lean, scripts/module-invariants-manifest.txt} -- C6 fails on either half alone (import without deletion makes five entries name reachable modules; deletion without import leaves five unreachable modules unmanifested)
Phase 1 opens with a pre-edit baseline build so a red post-edit build caused by a concurrent task editing FormalSystem/ is attributable rather than misread as an elaboration conflict
Did not re-run the Variant B adversarial experiment as a gate: F4 already measured it green, and repeating it is a non-goal

Added two edit sites beyond the report's F7/F8 enumeration where the same false claim recurs verbatim: Algebraic/README.md's Mathematical Overview step 3 (repeats the G/H interior-operator claim in expanded form) and Boneyard/README.md's UltrafilterFrame entry (repeats the elaboration-interference claim). Correcting one occurrence while leaving its twin would reinstate the error.
Prose phases carry Verification Tier: prose but still run check-module-invariants.sh --no-build, because C5/C12 scan FormalSystem/**/*.md for stale dotted and slash-form module paths
dead_ends: Line numbers cited from the report (:33, :154-158, :171) are treated as navigational hints only; every phase locates its edit sites by grep on quoted text, since a parallel task editing the same README would drift them

The Context Extension Recommendation (context/project/lean4/patterns/testing-archived-elaboration-hazards.md) is out of scope: it lives in agent-system/extensions/**, a different source store and task type
